lines.en: label ayanedorm5:
: Just a second!
lines.zh: : 等一下！

lines.en: A series of strange, loud noises leak through the bottom of the door and find their way into the hall.
lines.zh: 一连串奇怪的巨响从门缝底下漏出来，飘进了走廊。

lines.en: I can not, for the life of me, tell what’s going on in there, but seeing as this is Ayane we’re talking about, I guess anything is possible.
lines.zh: 我死也想不出里面在搞什么名堂，不过既然这是 Ayane，我想什么都有可能。

lines.en: : Do you...need help or something in there?
lines.zh: : 你……需要帮忙什么的吗？

lines.en: : S-Sensei?! Knocking on my door? Is this a dream?
lines.zh: : 老……老师？！在我门口敲门？这是在做梦吗？

lines.en: : Nope. What’s up, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 不是。怎么了，Ayane？

lines.en: : This better not be a prank! If I open that door and it's just Ami with a tape recorder, I'm going to be really mad!
lines.zh: : 最好不是恶作剧！如果我开门，结果只是 Ami 拿着录音机，我会非常生气的！

lines.en: : This isn't a recording, Ayane. I'm really here.
lines.zh: : 这不是录音，Ayane。我真的在这儿。

lines.en: : That's exactly what Ami would have had recorded since she knows I'd see through this ploy! I'm not falling for it.
lines.zh: : 这恰恰就是 Ami 会让人录的那句话，因为她知道我看得穿这套把戏！我不会上当的。

lines.en: : Ayane, let me in.
lines.zh: : Ayane，让我进去。

lines.en: : If you're Sensei...say something only Sensei would know about me!
lines.zh: : 如果你真是老师……说一件只有老师会知道的关于我的事！

lines.en: Oh, good. That's a thing I don't have any trouble with at all.
lines.zh: 哦，好。这件事我可一点都不犯难。

lines.en: : You know what? Maybe I'll just leave.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？也许我还是走吧。

lines.en: : You can't leave! If...that's really you I mean!
lines.zh: : 你不能走！如果……那真的是你的话！

lines.en: : Why are you the one that's knocking on the door now?
lines.zh: : 那现在为什么换成你在敲门了？

lines.en: : I don't know! I wasn't prepared for this! I still have to hide the bodies!
lines.zh: : 我不知道！我没准备好！我还得把尸体藏起来！

lines.en: : Is that what all that noise was in-
lines.zh: : 刚才那些声音就是——

lines.en: scene black
: Oh my God! It really {i}is{/i} you! Why are you still in the hall?
lines.zh: : 我的天！真的{i}是{/i}你！你为什么还在走廊里？

lines.en: : That's what I'd like to know...
lines.zh: : 这也正是我想知道的……

lines.en: : I'll make it up to you! Here, come inside!
lines.zh: : 我会补偿你的！来，进来吧！

lines.en: Ayane grabs my wrist and begins pulling me into her room, but something about how erratic she's being right now makes me a little hesitant to do what I came here for in the first place.
lines.zh: Ayane 抓住我的手腕，开始把我往她屋里拽。可她现在这副反常的样子，让我对我原本来这儿要做的事有点犹豫。

lines.en: That or I subconsciously believe she actually {i}is{/i} hiding bodies in here and I just don't want to be an accomplice to whatever crimes she commits outside of school hours.
lines.zh: 或者是我潜意识里真觉得她在这儿{i}藏着{/i}尸体，而我只是不想成为她在放学后犯下的任何罪行的同谋。

lines.en: show ayaneroomredux1
: You doing okay over there?
lines.zh: : 你那边还好吗？

lines.en: : You came to see {i}me!{/i} In my room! Alone! Without Ami or Maya or anybody! It finally happened!
lines.zh: : 你来看我了！在{i}我{/i}的房间！单独！没有 Ami、没有 Maya、没有任何人！终于发生了！

lines.en: : You, uhh...really like me, huh?
lines.zh: : 你，呃……真的喜欢我啊？

lines.en: scene ayaneroomredux2
: {i}Ahem.{/i}
: Yeah, I guess you could say that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我想你可以这么说。

lines.en: You know, if there's one thing I {i}really{/i} understand about this world so far, it's that Ayane has been interested in {i}me{/i} for pretty much as long as she's known me.
lines.zh: 你知道，如果说这世界到目前为止有什么是我{i}真正{/i}搞懂的，那就是 Ayane 几乎从认识我起就对{i}我{/i}有兴趣。

lines.en: I wasn't aware it was...this bad, though.
lines.zh: 不过我没意识到它已经……到这个地步了。

lines.en: She's acting like she's got front seats to some sort of boy-band concert and I'm a little worried that the next phase will involve her taking out a large foam finger and cheering me on as I rifle through her things.
lines.zh: 她那副样子像是拿到了某场男子乐队演唱会的前排票，而我有点担心下一个阶段是她掏出一根巨大的泡沫手指，在我翻她东西的时候给我加油助威。

lines.en: It's a strange assumption to make, I'm sure. But things are already a lot weirder than I expected when coming here, so I might as well try to go a little bigger with my expectations.
lines.zh: 我知道这假设很怪。但来这儿之后事情已经比我预想的怪得多了，所以我还不如把期望值再放大一点。

lines.en: Anyway, Ayane’s half of the dorm is as extravagant as I expected it to be all the way down to the very last thread of...her exceedingly large bed.
lines.zh: 总之，Ayane 那一半宿舍的奢华程度完全在我意料之中，一直到最后一丝线头……以及她那张大得过分的床。

lines.en: In fact, how did she even manage to get that thing in here? It's taking up half of the room.
lines.zh: 话说回来，她到底是怎么把那玩意儿弄进来的？它占了半个房间。

lines.en: scene ayaneroom1
I take a few steps forward and place the palm of my hand on her mattress, pressing down to see what sorts of things people with her amount of money get to fall asleep on at night.
lines.zh: 我往前走了几步，把手掌按在她的床垫上，压下去，想看看有她那么多钱的人晚上到底睡在什么上面。

lines.en: It feels like a weird halfway point between a sponge and a marshmallow and I'm not exactly sure if I like it, but I'm open to spending a night or seven inside of it to confirm.
lines.zh: 那感觉像是海绵和棉花糖之间一个奇怪的中间点，我不太确定自己喜不喜欢，不过我愿意在里面睡上一晚、或者七晚来确认一下。

lines.en: : Super comfy, right? The mattress was made in France and imported here right before the barrier was put up.
lines.zh: : 超级舒服吧？这床垫是法国做的，在屏障立起来之前直接进口过来的。

lines.en: : Fun fact: This is actually my bed from home. I had the movers bring it here at the beginning of the year when I moved in.
lines.zh: : 有趣的事实：这其实是我从家里带来的床。我年初搬进来的时候让搬家公司把它搬来了。

lines.en: : How did they get it to fit?
lines.zh: : 他们怎么让它塞进来的？

lines.en: : That's what she said.
lines.zh: : 她就是这么说的。

lines.en: : Okay, but really.
lines.zh: : 好吧，说真的。

lines.en: : They tore down the wall and rebuilt it, of course.
lines.zh: : 他们当然是把墙拆了又砌回去。

lines.en: : It made the halls a total mess for a whole day, but I think we can all agree it was worth it in the end.
lines.zh: : 走廊被搞得一整天乱七八糟，不过我想我们都同意最后很值。

lines.en: : Yes, I'm sure everyone else is very thankful that you get to sleep on a bed the size of their homes.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我确信其他人都非常感激你能睡在一张有他们家那么大的床上。

lines.en: : So...is there anything {i}else{/i} you see that you maybe want to comment on, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那么……你还看到{i}别的{/i}什么想点评一下的吗，老师？

lines.en: scene ayaneroom2
: Yes, actually. Thank you for reminding me.
lines.zh: : 有，其实。谢谢你提醒我。

lines.en: : What the fuck is this?
lines.zh: : 这他妈是什么？

lines.en: : My Sensei wall!
lines.zh: : 我的老师墙！

lines.en: : I'm going to need a better explanation than that.
lines.zh: : 我需要比这更好的解释。

lines.en: : Sure! When we moved in, they told us we could decorate our rooms with whatever we liked. So {i}obviously{/i} I was going to put up some of my favorite photos of you!
lines.zh: : 好呀！我们搬进来的时候，他们说我们可以随便装饰房间。所以{i}显然{/i}我要把你最好看的几张照片挂上去！

lines.en: : Am I...asleep in that one?
lines.zh: : 那张里我是……睡着的？

lines.en: : Yup! Ami has a copy of that one as well. It's one of our favorites.
lines.zh: : 对！Ami 也有一张一样的。那是我们最喜欢的之一。

lines.en: : We have an entire album of candid photos we've taken of you. These four are just scratching the surface.
lines.zh: : 我们有一整本偷拍你的相册。这四张只是冰山一角。

lines.en: Okay, this may be a bit of a problem.
lines.zh: 好吧，这可能有点麻烦。

lines.en: : You know, I'd be totally open to taking better pictures of you, but you're always so against being on camera and stuff.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我完全乐意给你拍更好看的照片，可你总是那么抗拒上镜什么的。

lines.en: : This seems like a major invasion of privacy.
lines.zh: : 这看起来严重侵犯隐私。

lines.en: : If you want to talk about invasions of privacy, you should see some of the stuff Ami has in her personal collection.
lines.zh: : 如果你想聊侵犯隐私，你该看看 Ami 私人收藏里的一些东西。

lines.en: : Don't get me wrong, I love it. But it's actually a little creepy that she's so adamant about keeping those ones to herself when you guys are related.
lines.zh: : 别误会，我很喜欢。不过你们是亲戚，她却那么坚持只留给自己，说实话有点瘆人。

lines.en: : That's fine, though. I'll get back at her with my own secret stash soon enough now that you're willing to come to my room!
lines.zh: : 不过没关系。既然你现在愿意来我房间了，我很快也会有自己的秘密存货来回敬她！

lines.en: scene ayaneroom3
: You love it, right?! Doesn't it warm your heart knowing that your niece's best friend goes to sleep every night with a photo collage of candid pictures of your sometimes-sleeping body?
lines.zh: : 你很喜欢，对吧？！想到你[niece]最好的朋友每晚都带着一张你（有时是睡着的）身体的偷拍拼图入睡，是不是心里暖暖的？

lines.en: : That seemed like a mouthful.
lines.zh: : 那句话听起来好绕。

lines.en: : I will assure you my mouth can fit much more!
lines.zh: : 我保证我的嘴能装下更多！

lines.en: : I will...definitely remember that.
lines.zh: : 我……一定会记住这句话的。

lines.en: : So, what do you think I should do? Add more to it? Leave it the way it is? I want your input since you {i}are{/i} the inspiration behind it and everything.
lines.zh: : 那么，你觉得我该怎么做？再多加点？还是就这样？我想要你的意见，因为你{i}就是{/i}这一切的灵感来源什么的。

lines.en: menu:
: It's certainly very...{i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 它 certainly 非常……像{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: scene ayaneroom4
: I know!
lines.zh: : 我知道！

lines.en: : Moving into dorms for the first time was definitely a little scary...but as long as I have you next to me, I feel ten times safer!
lines.zh: : 第一次住进宿舍确实有点害怕……可只要有你在我身边，我就觉得安全十倍！

lines.en: How exactly did she manage to say something to make me {i}kind of{/i} okay with this?
lines.zh: 她到底是怎么说出一句让我对这事{i}有点{/i}释然的话的？

lines.en: Yes, it is obviously still very creepy...but now it's cute as well and I wasn't expecting to come around to this so soon.
lines.zh: 没错，它显然还是很瘆人……可现在它也可爱了，而我没料到自己这么快就想通了。

lines.en: This is terrifying
lines.zh: 这太可怕了。

lines.en: : Ayane, this is absolutely terrifying.
lines.zh: : Ayane，这绝对太可怕了。

lines.en: scene ayaneroom5
: What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : Well...how would you feel if you walked into someone's room and there were pictures of you all over the wall?
lines.zh: : 嗯……要是你走进别人房间，发现满墙都是你的照片，你会怎么想？

lines.en: scene ayaneroom5r
: Loved.
lines.zh: : 被爱着。

lines.en: : Really? That's it?
lines.zh: : 真的？就这个？

lines.en: : Yes. And I'd even be happy to print some out for you if you have some extra wall space and want to fall asleep next to me without Ami killing us.
lines.zh: : 对。如果你有多余的墙面，而且想挨着我睡、又不会被 Ami 杀了，我甚至乐意给你打印一些出来。

lines.en: : Something tells me she wouldn't be very happy about pictures, either.
lines.zh: : 我有种感觉，她对照片也不会太高兴。

lines.en: : Does this really scare you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 这真的吓到你了吗，老师？

lines.en: : Well...it's less {i}scary{/i} and more...I don't know- creepy?
lines.zh: : 嗯……与其说{i}吓人{/i}，不如说……我不知道——瘆人？

lines.en: scene ayaneroom5r2
: I'll take them down if you want.
lines.zh: : 如果你想，我可以把它们取下来。

lines.en: : I just liked how they made me feel and...
lines.zh: : 我只是喜欢它们带给我的感觉，而且……

lines.en: : I miss you when you're not around sometimes...
lines.zh: : 你不在的时候我有时会想你……

lines.en: : Ugh. Fine.
lines.zh: : 唉。行吧。

lines.en: : You can keep them up. Just stop taking pictures of me while I'm asleep. That is where I draw the line.
lines.zh: : 你可以留着。别再拍我睡着的照片就行。那条线我画在这儿。

lines.en: scene ayaneroom5r3
: That is a line I'd be happy to deal with!
lines.zh: : 那条线我很乐意遵守！

lines.en: scene ayaneroom3
: So, now that we’re alone, what did you want to do?
lines.zh: : 那么，既然我们独处了，你想干什么？

lines.en: : My bed is practically {i}made{/i} for cuddling, you know. And it's big enough that we could hide under the blanket and it would take Sana roughly five years to find us.
lines.zh: : 我的床基本就是为拥抱{i}而生{/i}的，你知道。而且它够大，我们可以躲在被子底下，Sana 大概要花五年才能找到我们。

lines.en: : As fair warning, I'd very likely wind up shooting for a little more than just {i}cuddling{/i} if we got into that bed together, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 先说清楚，如果我俩一起上了那张床，我很可能会想要的比单纯{i}拥抱{/i}更多一点，Ayane。

lines.en: scene ayaneroom6
: Oh! You...
: I mean...
lines.zh: : 我是说……

lines.en: : I'm obviously not {i}opposed...{/i}
lines.zh: : 我显然不{i}反对……{/i}

lines.en: : Like...if the bed is made for cuddling, it's...obviously pretty suited for stuff like that too...
lines.zh: : 就像……如果这张床是为拥抱而生的，那它……显然也挺适合干那种事的……

lines.en: : And if it's with you...
lines.zh: : 而且如果是跟你……

lines.en: : You're nervous, aren't you?
lines.zh: : 你紧张了，对吧？

lines.en: scene ayaneroom7
: Uhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……

lines.en: : I don't know if nervous is the right word because I am...{i}definitely{/i} feeling something else just thinking about that...
lines.zh: : 我不知道「紧张」是不是合适的词，因为光是想想那个，我……{i}肯定{/i}在感受着别的什么……

lines.en: : But I also...kind of have a weird request that I'd like to run by you if that...doesn't take away from the mood too much...
lines.zh: : 不过我也……有个奇怪的请求想先跟你说一声，如果那……不太扫兴的话……

lines.en: : It must be one hell of a fetish if you have to warn me beforehand.
lines.zh: : 如果需要提前警告我，那癖好肯定非同小可。

lines.en: scene ayaneroom7r
: It's not a fetish! It's just...
lines.zh: : 那不是癖好！只是……

lines.en: : If we're...uhh...okay with...taking things in that direction...
lines.zh: : 如果我们……呃……打算往那个方向发展的话……

lines.en: scene ayaneroom7r2
: I kinda...want to skip all the other stuff first...
lines.zh: : 我有点……想把前面那些步骤全跳过去……

lines.en: : As in-
lines.zh: : 意思是——

lines.en: scene ayaneroom7r3
: As in I...kind of...maybe...want to have sex with you?...
lines.zh: : 意思是我……有点……也许……想跟你做爱？……

lines.en: : If that's okay to say...which it might not be since you have basically raised me the last few years and it would be all sorts of wrong from like a million different angles-
lines.zh: : 如果这么说可以的话……虽然可能不太行，毕竟这几年基本是你在把我带大，从一百万个角度看都各种不对——

lines.en: : But...I kind of also {i}really{/i} want to?...
lines.zh: : 可是……我也{i}真的{/i}很想？……

lines.en: : Like...like now?
lines.zh: : 像……像现在吗？

lines.en: scene ayaneroom7r4
: No no no no no, definitely not now. I don't even have any idea when Sana is going to be home.
lines.zh: : 不不不不不，绝对不是现在。我连 Sana 什么时候回来都不知道。

lines.en: : I just...want my first experience to be a really special one that we can kind of, like...prepare for or something.
lines.zh: : 我只是……希望我的第一次是一次真正特别的经历，我们俩可以，呃……事先准备一下什么的。

lines.en: scene ayaneroom7r5
: But after that, I'll basically let you do anything you want to me wherever you want to do it.
lines.zh: : 不过在那之后，我基本会让你在任何地方、对我做任何你想做的事。

lines.en: : You know, it was really cute seeing you embarrassed for the fifteen seconds you were able to hold it.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，你能维持住那十五秒的害羞，看着还挺可爱的。

lines.en: : Oh, I'm still very embarrassed. But I also trust you with all of me, Sensei. Whether it be my heart or my body...
lines.zh: : 哦，我现在还是非常害羞。可我也把我的一切都托付给你了，老师。无论是我的心还是我的身体……

lines.en: : When we connect, I want it to be real.
lines.zh: : 当我们连在一起的时候，我希望它是真的。

lines.en: scene ayaneroom7r6
: So, uhh...despite how badly I'm sure both of us want to {i}cuddle{/i} right now...we should probably hold off or we'll wind up jumping the gun and-
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……虽然我确信我俩现在都很想{i}抱在一起{/i}……我们大概还是该忍住，不然我们会提前——

lines.en: : Hold on a second, I never agreed to this proposal.
lines.zh: : 等等，我可没同意这个提议。

lines.en: scene ayaneroom7r7
: Huh?
: You said you wanted to ask me something and then just went off about your big plans without giving me the chance to respond to them.
lines.zh: : 你说你想问我一件事，然后就自顾自地讲起了你的宏大计划，根本没给我回应的机会。

lines.en: : So...you're not okay with...skipping straight to the end of the race?...
lines.zh: : 所以……你不同意……直接冲到比赛终点？……

lines.en: : Oh, I'm totally okay with it. I just wanted to be involved in the decision making process.
lines.zh: : 哦，我完全同意。我只是想参与一下决策过程。

lines.en: scene ayaneroom7r8
: Sensei, what the heck?! That had me really worried for a second!
lines.zh: : 老师，搞什么鬼？！你刚才吓死我了！

lines.en: : Did you honestly think I'd turn that down?
lines.zh: : 你真以为我会拒绝那个吗？

lines.en: : I had no idea what to think! It's the first time I've ever made plans to lose my virginity!
lines.zh: : 我根本不知道该想什么！这可是我第一次计划着要失去处女身！

lines.en: : Well, I can't guarantee I'll be able to make it special. But if you want to {i}skip straight to the end of the race,{/i} we can do that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不能保证我能让它变得特别。但如果你想{i}直接冲到比赛终点{/i}，我们可以。

lines.en: scene ayaneroom8
: Just agreeing to be with me makes it more special than I could have ever wished for, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 光是你答应跟我在一起，就已经比我能许愿的都更特别了，老师。

lines.en: : I'm sorry if I'm moving too fast, I just...
lines.zh: : 如果我进展太快了，我很抱歉，我只是……

lines.en: : I know what I want. And I know {i}who{/i} I want.
lines.zh: : 我知道我想要什么。也知道我想要{i}谁{/i}。

lines.en: : You just happen to be both of those things.
lines.zh: : 而你恰好两样都是。

lines.en: scene black
So...already, huh?
lines.zh: 所以……已经到这一步了吗？

lines.en: I didn't even have to work for it.
lines.zh: 我甚至都没费一点力气。

lines.en: I simply put on someone else's nametag, took a few steps forward, and was wrongly gifted a bouquet of the world's most delicate flowers without so much as a background check.
lines.zh: 我只是戴上了别人的胸牌，往前走了几步，就被错误地赠与了一束世上最娇嫩的花，连背景调查都没做。

lines.en: Desperation and loneliness make a vicious cocktail, don't they?
lines.zh: 绝望和孤独调成的鸡尾酒很凶，不是吗？

lines.en: Ayane must be so blindsided by the object of her perpetual affection leaning into her that she's abandoned all rationality in blind hope that true love is real.
lines.zh: Ayane 一定是被她长久爱慕的对象主动靠过来冲昏了头，才会在「真爱是真的」这种盲目希望里放弃了全部理性。

lines.en: I lift the bouquet to my nose and breathe in the scent of someone else's job well done.
lines.zh: 我把花束举到鼻尖，嗅着别人的劳动成果的香气。

lines.en: I will remember it again when the time comes to change a girl's life.
lines.zh: 等到要改变一个女孩人生的那一刻，我会再次想起它。

lines.en: I shouldn't be doing this.
lines.zh: 我不该做这件事。

lines.en: I shouldn't.
lines.zh: 我不该。

lines.en: But I will.
lines.zh: 但我会。

lines.en: Because it matters not what we should or shouldn't do when what we want is ten times louder.
lines.zh: 因为当「我们想要的」响上十倍的时候，「该不该」就无关紧要了。

lines.en: The weakest link is the first to break.
lines.zh: 最薄弱的那一环最先断。

lines.en: Everything else follows.
lines.zh: 其余的跟着来。

lines.en: $ ayane_love += 1
$ ayanedorm5 = True

lines.zh: {i}Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]！你现在可以去她房间陪她了！{/i}
